roles.title: Roles and access
roles.name: Role name
roles.newBody: The new role starts with dashboard access only. Choose its capabilities separately.
roles.intro: WordPress administrators can access everything. Saved changes apply immediately to the selected roles.
roles.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. This operation discards them and loads the current settings.
roles.saveBody: The selected capabilities will apply immediately to everyone with these roles.
roles.resetBody: Reset the selected role’s catalog capabilities to their defaults.
roles.deleteBody: This custom role will be deleted. People with no other role move to the site’s default role.
roles.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Compare with the current settings before saving.
roles.refHelp: A donation made during this period is linked to the referring person. Opening another referral link replaces the previous referral.
roles.removeBody: Remove {{name}} from this role. If no other role remains, the default role is assigned.
roles.assignBody: Add {{who}} to this role. Other Flux roles and subscriber/customer roles will be removed.
roles.updateRequired: Update the site’s Flux Roles package to use this app screen.

languages.title: Languages
languages.saveBody: These settings update language selection and the text visitors see on the site.
languages.defaultWarning: Changing the default language can change language prefixes and content URLs. Apply the new settings?
languages.removeBody: Remove {{language}} from settings. This does not delete translated content. Save to apply the change.
languages.intro: The default language uses the main address; other languages use prefixes such as /en/.
languages.name: Name
languages.inactiveHelp: New languages start inactive. Prepare content and install the language pack before enabling them.
languages.fallback: Show the default-language content when no translation exists
languages.redirect: Open directly in a suitable language
languages.suggestionHelp: Use two-letter country codes (TR, CY…). Logged-in users and search engine bots are never redirected automatically.
languages.defaultTexts: Manage default-language text in site and SEO settings. Select another language on the left to edit its translations.
languages.textHelp: Empty fields fall back to the default-language text.
languages.aiHelp: Use the AI assistant to prepare translations of content and site text. The assistant asks for approval before making changes.
languages.updateRequired: Update the site’s Flux Lang package to use this app screen.

aiMcp.title: MCP connections
aiMcp.intro: Connect external AI clients to the tools registered on this site.
aiMcp.ownerHelp: The key uses your current site permissions. Choose only the tools the client needs. Creating a key does not turn on the server.
aiMcp.name: Key name
aiMcp.allHelp: This key can access every current and future tool allowed by its owner’s permissions.
aiMcp.stale: MCP settings changed. Refresh and reset this form before creating a key.
aiMcp.off: MCP server is off. Existing keys cannot connect.
aiMcp.approvalHelp: Tools run with the key owner’s permissions. External MCP clients must request approval for changes; this server does not provide an interactive approval step for each call.
aiMcp.once: Shown once for up to five minutes. Copy it to your password manager before closing this panel. It cannot be retrieved again.
aiMcp.urlWarning: The connection URL contains the key. Treat it as a password; do not share or open it in a browser. Prefer an Authorization header when supported.
aiMcp.connectHelp: For desktop clients that support MCP server configuration, add this entry. Replace YOUR_MCP_KEY with a key you saved. The copy buttons do not install or run anything.
aiMcp.headerHelp: Use the Authorization: Bearer header when supported. If your hosting strips Authorization, forward that header in the server configuration.
aiMcp.legacy: An older Flux SEO MCP server is active. Update it before managing keys here.
aiMcp.confirmCreate: Create a key for {{site}} with access to {{scope}}? It will use your site permissions. Store the key safely; it will be shown once.
aiMcp.confirmEnable: Turn on the MCP server for {{site}}? Existing keys will be able to connect.
aiMcp.confirmDisable: Turn off the MCP server for {{site}}? All MCP clients will lose access until it is enabled again.
aiMcp.confirmRevoke: Permanently revoke “{{name}}” (owner: {{owner}}) on {{site}}? Clients using it will lose access. A replacement key can be created.
aiMcp.keyUrl: Connection URL for clients without headers
